Subject: SIG request and a couple potential exceptions

Hi David,

Thanks for taking the SIG. We're preparing the procurement packet for the production pilot and need the completed SIG (and any CAIQ/SOC2 evidence) by end of week. A couple of items stood out on our preliminary scan where we expect non-standard answers:

- Data retention of KV/prefix caches for multi-tenant inference (question 4.2)
- Audit log granularity for per-request metadata (question 7.1)

If either of those are marked as an exception, please include the proposed compensating controls and an expected timeline to remediate / roadmap commitment. Our security team will need an internal signoff for any exceptions (CTO or Head of Security preferred).

Can you attach the SIG answers and any evidence (SOC2 summary, architecture diagrams)? Deadline: Fri 2026-06-18.

Best,

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up.

Please find attached our completed SIG answers (SIG_Answers_v0.9.xlsx) and a short SOC 2 evidence summary. I flagged two items in the spreadsheet as non-standard:

1) Q4.2 (KV/prefix cache retention) — current behavior: ephemeral KV cache persisted for forensic debugging and model tuning for up to 30 days. Reason: improves hot-start latency and model evaluation.
2) Q7.1 (audit log retention/granularity) — we currently provide per-request metadata (timestamps, model id, route) but do not persist full input payloads by default; retention is 90 days for structured logs.

For both items I annotated proposed compensating controls (customer-managed KMS, field-level redaction, scoped SOC2 evidence) and a roadmap commitment to add per-customer retention profiles + configurable audit log export within ~12 weeks (AI-1593).

Given FinBank's regulatory posture, I think these will require an exception signoff and an executive confirmation of the roadmap timeline (CTO or VP Product). Can we loop in legal/security for a short internal review? If you confirm acceptance of the compensating controls we can prepare the formal exception form.

David
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: SIG request and a couple potential exceptions

Elena — appreciate the quick review. Per our internal discussion, here's what we're proposing for FinBank:

1) Scope of exception (temporary):
   - KV/prefix cache retention: we will allow up to 30 days retention for the pilot environment only.
   - Audit logs: structured per-request metadata will be retained for 90 days; full payload export can be enabled for FinBank on request.

2) Compensating controls:
   - Customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest
   - Field-level redaction for PII before persistence
   - Isolated pilot deployment / dedicated capacity pool
   - SOC2 Type II evidence and a walkthrough call with our security team (we attached a summary)

3) Roadmap commitment: Redwood will deliver per-customer retention settings and exportable, configurable audit logs (AI-1593) targeted by 2026-09-01. We are prepared to have Monica or our VP Product provide an exec-level confirmation and a brief note for your procurement.

Action requested from FinBank: Please confirm if FinBank will accept the above temporary exception with compensating controls until 2026-09-01 (or propose an earlier remediation deadline). Once confirmed we'll produce the official exception addendum for a CTO signature.

Attachments: SIG_Answers_v0.9.xlsx, redwood_sig_exception_form.pdf, SOC2-Type2-evidence-summary.pdf

Thanks,
David
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
